info.title: PlasticDB API — SDK contract
info.description: The contract the PlasticDB Python and R SDKs are built against: the anonymous public read API (`/api/v1/openapi.public.json`) plus the compute operations an API-key holder uses (job submission, the bioinformatics pipelines, the taxonomy tree, the caller's own jobs and share links). Admin, curation, ingestion, forum, chat, settings and submission routes are left out; the complete reference is `/openapi.json`. `info.version` is the contract version, not the server release. Until the first public release the contract may change; after it, `/api/v1` changes are additive only.

evalue.title: Evalue
evalue.description: E-value threshold passed directly to DIAMOND (e.g. 1e-5). Range: (0, 10]. For hmm_screen it applies only with threshold_mode=evalue.

threshold_mode.description: hmm_screen: how a hit is called. `gathering` (default) runs hmmsearch --cut_ga, each profile's calibrated gathering (GA) cut-off, and ignores `evalue`. `evalue` runs hmmsearch -E <evalue> only — exploratory, for distant homologues that score below a profile's GA. If the published library has a profile without a GA line, a gathering screen falls back to the E-value and records why on the job.
